attack_quote: This was due to the proxies that route requests to our search clusters running out of CPU while setting up encrypted connections.

contributing_factors.source_quote: Requests that timed out were retried, which added more load and kept the proxies overloaded.
contributing_factors.text: Requests that timed out were retried, which added more load and kept the search proxies overloaded.

fixes.source_quote: We mitigated the incident by adding proxy capacity
fixes.text: Mitigated the incident by adding proxy capacity.

fixes.source_quote: We have started reducing the CPU cost of these encrypted connections.
fixes.text: Reduce the CPU cost of the encrypted connections.

fixes.source_quote: make search retries adjustable during an incident without a deployment
fixes.text: Make search retries adjustable during an incident without a deployment.

root_cause.source_quote: This was due to the proxies that route requests to our search clusters running out of CPU while setting up encrypted connections.
root_cause.text: The proxies that route requests to GitHub's search clusters ran out of CPU while setting up encrypted connections, so search and the search-backed features in Issues, Pull Requests, Projects, Actions, Packages, and some REST API endpoints returned errors or incomplete results.

timeline.event: Search on GitHub.com became degraded, with search-backed features returning errors or incomplete results.
timeline.source_quote: between 14:55 and 17:28 UTC, search on GitHub.com was degraded

timeline.event: Search recovered after proxy capacity was added.
timeline.source_quote: after which search recovered at 17:28 UTC
